notes:
Describes food that is excessively oily or greasy, or skin that has an oily feel. Usually carries a slightly negative nuance, suggesting too much oil. Formed with ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (oil) + ⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧ (tending to be; having the quality of).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {油|あぶら}っぽい⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧: greasy food
- {油|あぶら}っぽい⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: oily skin
- {油|あぶら}っぽい⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: greasy cooking
- {油|あぶら}っぽいもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧: cut back on greasy food

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦こってり→こってり：06681_kotteri⟧: rich; heavy — describes food with deep, rich flavor from oil or fat, often used positively for ramen or sauces
- ⟦あっさり→あっさり：05650_assari⟧: light; plain — the opposite of ⟦こってり→こってり：06681_kotteri⟧, describing food with a clean, simple taste
- ⟦{脂|あぶら}っこい→脂っこい：14728_aburakkoi⟧: oily; greasy — similar meaning to {油|あぶら}っぽい, sometimes written with ⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧ (animal fat) instead of ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (oil)

NOTE ON KANJI:
⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ refers to oil in general (cooking oil, petroleum), while ⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧ refers to animal or body fat. Both can be used in this word.
